verdict.rationale: Lindy is itself an AI agent ('an AI employee'), so it fills the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents is a different product role. The MCP page describes only client-side use: Lindy is pointed at hosted MCP servers and builds actions from their tools. The probe's 'official MCP server documented' label points to that same client-side page, and there is no explicit evidence that Lindy runs as an MCP server itself, so the server axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
